rawEvidenceArchive.contents: Four original CapFrameX JSON captures plus this evidence manifest

hardware: AMD Ryzen 9 7900X; NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070; ASUS ROG STRIX B650E-I GAMING WIFI; 32 GB DDR5 (6000 MT/s default, 6200 MT/s SoftheOS)
bios: Default profile: standard settings with XMP enabled. SoftheOS profile: modified ASUS BIOS 3854 with Softhe.io BIOS tuning.
drivers: NVIDIA 591.86 in the default profile; NVIDIA 537.58 in the SoftheOS profile. CapFrameX did not record chipset-driver versions.
operatingSystem: Default: Microsoft Windows 11 Home Build 26200. SoftheOS: Microsoft Windows 11 IoT Enterprise LTSC Build 26200 with the Softhe.io OS build.
gameVersion: Counter-Strike 2 build current at capture time; the exact build identifier was not recorded by CapFrameX.
graphicsSettings: Fullscreen Windowed; 4:3; 1280x960; 360 Hz; maximum in-game FPS 0; maximum menu FPS 200; MSAA none; global shadows low; dynamic shadows all; model/texture medium; anisotropic 16x; shader low; particles low; ambient occlusion disabled; HDR quality; FidelityFX Super Resolution disabled (highest quality). Identical game configuration and video settings for all runs.
scenario: Counter-Strike 2 Dust2 FPS Benchmark workshop map recorded with CapFrameX 1.8.6.2 for 109 seconds per run.
warmupProcedure: Clean fresh boot with only Steam and CapFrameX running before the two consecutive benchmark runs for each profile.
